title: GB Bank finances £62m London property portfolio deal
summary:
GB Bank has provided two financing facilities totalling £62 million for the acquisition and refinancing of residential, retail and office properties across London. The transactions, arranged by SHC Capital, involve investment and stretched senior funding secured against tenanted multi-asset portfolios generating rental income.

The post GB Bank finances £62m London property portfolio deal appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Family secures £16.2m refinance on South London asset
summary:
United Trust Bank has provided a £16.2m investment facility to refinance a £26.9m mixed-use property in South London, held by the Patel family for more than 35 years. The deal was structured at 61% loan-to-value on a five-year fixed-rate term.

The post Family secures £16.2m refinance on South London asset appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Parents return half of adult children’s rent for deposits
summary:
Over half of parents charging rent to adult children living at home return some or all of the money to help them save for a property deposit, according to research by Nationwide Building Society. The survey of more than 2,000 parents found that 54% use rent payments as a savings mechanism for their children's homeownership ambitions.

title: Landlords retain legal liability despite agent appointments
summary:
Landlords remain legally responsible for compliance failures even when using letting agents, according to industry warnings as regulatory requirements continue to expand across the rental sector. Local authorities can issue civil penalties up to £7,000 per breach, with serious offences attracting fines up to £40,000.

title: Government confirms new first-time buyer scheme
summary:
The Government has confirmed plans for a new equity loan scheme aimed at first-time buyers, with full details to be announced at next month's Budget. The 'Your First Home' scheme will support 2.5% deposits backed by 20% government-backed equity loans for new-build properties.

The post Government confirms new first-time buyer scheme appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Martin & Co franchisee acquires Basingstoke branch
summary:
David Rebe has acquired the Martin & Co Basingstoke franchise, expanding his portfolio to three branches within the network. The acquisition follows his initial entry into the franchise system in March 2024 with the Oxford and Thame operations.

title: UK buyers show less flexibility on property compromises
summary:
British homebuyers are less willing to adjust their expectations, finances and lifestyles to purchase property compared to buyers in other major English-speaking markets, according to new research from property data firm Cotality.

The post UK buyers show less flexibility on property compromises appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Tenant group petitions to end insured deposit schemes
summary:
A tenant advocacy organisation has submitted a petition with 17,000 signatures to Housing Secretary Angela Rayner calling for the abolition of insured deposit schemes. Generation Rent argues the current system allows landlords to retain deposits during dispute processes, with only one in five renters challenging deductions despite 79% success rates.

title: Five rural homes listed near foraging locations across UK
summary:
Five residential properties located near foraging locations in England, Scotland and Wales have been listed for sale, with prices ranging from £775,000 to £1.25 million. The listings include properties in Brecon, Wiltshire, Somerset, Carmarthenshire and East Lothian.

title: £206k bridging loan funds Liverpool property renovation
summary:
A £206,000 bridging finance facility has been arranged to support the purchase and refurbishment of a six-bedroom detached property in Liverpool that had been vacant for over a decade. The 12-month facility enables the borrowers to complete renovation works before refinancing onto longer-term debt.
